description: Airhand relay server: QUIC signalling and forwarding for the Airhand remote desktop
notes: Runs on UDP 4433 by default. Set AIRHAND_LISTEN to change it, for example "127.0.0.1:4433".

The certificate, its private key and the SQLite database are created automatically in a "data" folder next to airhand-server.exe, which is versioned by Scoop. Keep a copy of that folder when you uninstall, or clients that pin the certificate fingerprint will refuse to connect.
